CustomField.description: Indicates the current completion status of required re-enrollment forms based on student type, enrollment status, intent to return, and form activity. Values reflect whether re-enrollment has not started, is in progress, is complete, or is not applicable.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Indicates the current completion status of required re-enrollment forms based on student type, enrollment status, intent to return, and form activity. Values reflect whether re-enrollment has not started, is in progress, is complete, or is not applicable.
CustomField.label: Re-Enrollment Forms Status
